artworks.title: A La Vieillesse (To Old Age)
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of an elderly man. He is looking downwards and to the right. The portrait highlights his facial features, including a pronounced nose, deep-set eyes, and a long beard. His hair is depicted as sparse on top and fuller and curly on the sides and back. The focus is on the face and upper shoulders, with a plain background. There are no clothing details or accessories in the drawing. The image is rendered in grayscale on a paper surface.

artworks.title: Arbre (Tree)
artworks.description: The image is a minimalistic line drawing of a tree, seen from a direct front-on perspective. The horizon is not defined, creating a flat composition. The tree is centered, with the trunk and branches extending upward. The branches have small, delicate leaves drawn with fine lines, maintaining a consistent texture. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of beige and gray. There are no other background elements, focusing solely on the tree itself.

artworks.title: Ari
artworks.description: The image shows two sketches of a child's head and shoulders. One sketch is a front-facing view, capturing the upper body from the top of the head to just below the shoulders. The child is looking directly outward, with softly detailed facial features including eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is short and unkempt, depicted with textured strokes. The child wears a garment outlined rather than detailed, and there are no accessories. The second sketch is a profile view of the same child, showing only the head with minimal outlines and shading. The background is a plain, creamy sheet of paper signed 'ARI 1898'.

artworks.title: Cellule Auriculaire (Auricular Cell)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's face in profile, facing right. The face is enclosed within a circular frame, displaying soft yet distinct facial features, with closed eyes, a slightly protruding nose, and flowing hair. The background is intricately shaded, complementing the dark composition, with the person's ear visible, adorned with a long dangling earring. The focus is on the face, with no visible clothing.

artworks.title: Femme de Profil (Profile of a Woman)
artworks.description: The image depicts a series of intricately drawn lines and soft curves forming an abstract composition. A figure's profile is prominent, focusing on hair and facial features with detailed emphasis. The hair has swirling patterns, resembling ornate headpieces. In the background, angular lines suggest a frame-like structure, along with geometric shapes like circles and a cube with dots akin to a die. The composition combines elements suggesting a portrait with deeper complexities.

artworks.title: Lumiere (Light)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large face in an arched frame, observed by two smaller figures. The face has closed eyes and a contemplative expression, with a hand resting against its chin. It is surrounded by a dark frame, giving the appearance of being part of a grand sculpture within a hall. Two small silhouetted figures stand below, looking up at the face. Cross-hatching and shadows are used to add depth and texture, creating a dramatic scene.

artworks.title: Saint Cecilia
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals standing close together. The central figure, a young woman, holds panpipes and has loose wavy hair. Four other individuals surround her: a man with curly hair holding a sword, a youthful figure with long hair, an older man in a mitre reading a book, and a woman holding a vase with long hair. They are all dressed in flowing robes. Four angels above them play musical instruments while another rests its head on folded arms. The background has clouds and the ground has books and musical instruments.

artworks.title: David and Goliath
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures in combat amidst a crowd. The scene depicts an intense confrontation where one figure, heavily armored with a prominent helmet and shield, appears engaged in battle. The other figure is smaller in stature and dressed in simpler, period-appropriate attire, and is wielding a staff or similar object. The setting is an open area surrounded by grass, with a group of onlookers or soldiers partially visible in the background, observing the duel. The texture and detail in the drawing imply movement and tension, capturing the drama of the encounter.

artworks.title: Maternity (Maternite)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of two figures, possibly a mother and child. The larger figure's head is turned slightly, with their eyes closed and a serene expression. The smaller figure, with closed eyes, is nestled close to the larger figure's chest. The figures have different hair lengths, and their clothing is implied through texture and shading. The background is abstract and textured, enhancing the focus on the figures. Details like jewelry are minimal, emphasizing the emotional tone conveyed through the figures' positioning and expressions.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: The image shows a nativity scene with animals and angels. It depicts a baby in a manger, surrounded by a donkey and an ox in a stable with a thatched roof. Two angels in the sky hold a scroll. The style resembles woodcut illustrations from the Renaissance period, with detailed textures and linework. The background shows a landscape with trees and hills.

artworks.title: The Battle of Saint James at Clavijo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper (with offset of same composition on verso)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to platemark): 29.5 x 43.5 cm (11 5/8 x 17 1/8 in.)

artworks.title: Virgin and Child with the Apple
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing and holding a child in her arms. The woman is upright, slightly bending her head towards the child. Her facial features are softly detailed with a serene expression, and her hair is long and wavy, cascading over her shoulders. She wears a flowing gown with elaborate folds and an ornate design. The child rests in her arms, facing forward, with curly hair, wearing a simple garment. The woman holds the child gently, supporting him with both hands. The background is plain, with no distinct scenery or objects.

artworks.title: The Rape of Ganymede
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil sketch of two figures. One figure is in the top left, leaning forward with an outstretched arm. This figure has curly hair and wears draped clothing. The second figure is in the lower right, reclined with one knee bent. This figure also has curly hair and is covered by a draped cloth. Both figures' expressions are intense. The background features textured shading for depth and movement, with contrast highlighting the figures' fluid positions. In the lower right corner, there is a stylized script inscription.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Cows
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with cows resting and grazing in a landscape. The view is from a slightly elevated angle, capturing the horizon, a distant hill or mountain, and a group of trees. The lithographic print uses fine linework to depict textures in the foliage and trees. The color palette is black and off-white, typical of lithographs. A large, weathered tree is prominent on the right side of the composition.

artworks.title: Old Water Mill
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic landscape with a large watermill in the center, surrounded by foliage. A stream curves through the foreground, with two figures nearby. The surroundings are detailed in a monochrome palette of ink sketches, depicting trees, rocks, and a sky filled with tree branches.

artworks.title: Landscape with Large Tree, Castle on Left
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree in the foreground. In the middle ground, there is a castle-like structure on top of a rocky cliff. A small house or cottage is also visible, surrounded by hills in the background. The scene is rendered with detailed brush or pen strokes in a monochrome color palette, highlighting textures and contrast between light and shadow. The sky is clear.

artworks.title: Study of an Old Oak Tree, Water on Right, a Man on Left
artworks.description: The image shows a large, dominant tree captured from a lower and front-facing perspective. The horizon is low, with expansive sky above. In the distance, a small figure walks along a path near the tree. The artist used precise, linear brushstrokes to depict details in the tree's bark and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white to emphasize contrast and detail. The sky has soft, wispy lines suggesting clouds.

artworks.title: Cattle Resting
artworks.description: The image shows two resting cattle in a rural landscape. A split wooden fence crosses the scene, with trees and foliage blocking the view of the horizon. The style is detailed with intricate line work, using black ink on cream paper to emphasize textures and shading. The cattle are on grassy ground, surrounded by trees and bushes in the background.

artworks.title: Apollo as a Warrior
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical warrior figure. The image depicts a muscular figure with Greek or Roman attributes, such as a helmet and sandals, soaring through an array of stylized clouds. The figure is poised with a spear in an action stance, and is adorned with intricately detailed armor and a billowing cape. The background, composed of swirling lines, adds dynamic energy. The line work is fine and precise.

artworks.title: Marine: Fishing Boats on Shore, Man with Oars, Ship in Distance
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with sailboats on the water and a small boat beached on the shore with a person inside. Another person is walking along the shore with oars, accompanied by a dog. The painting style features detailed lines showing texture and movement in the water and clouds. The color palette is mainly black and white, giving the scene a classic look. The sky has detailed clouds, and birds are flying above.

artworks.title: Wild Horses
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two horses, one bending down and the other looking alert. The horizon is high with trees and hills in the distance. The composition has detailed brushstrokes capturing the horses and trees with fluid lines and light shading. The color scheme is black and gray, giving the drawing a classic black-and-white aesthetic. There are shrubs and grass in the foreground leading to the horses, with wooded hills in the background.

artworks.title: Horses at Cottage Door
artworks.description: The image shows two figures and a horse closely grouped together. One person is beside the horse holding its bridle, while the other is mounted on the horse. A dog is near the person on the ground. A thatched building with an open door is to the left. The scene has a monochromatic, sepia-like palette. In the distance to the right, there are small thatched rooftops surrounded by trees.

artworks.title: Study of Trees and Shrubs with Seated Figure
artworks.description: The image features a slightly elevated angle looking down into a scene dominated by a large, twisting tree. The horizon is not distinctly visible, as the landscape is filled with dense foliage and trees. Some buildings are faintly seen in the distance on the right side, partially obscured by trees. The style showcases intricate detailed line work emphasizing the texture of the tree bark and foliage, likely created through etching. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of black against the creamy paper. A lone figure sits on the ground close to us, partially shaded by the tree. The composition maintains a balanced interplay between the dense tree leaves and the open spaces towards the depicted buildings in the distance.
